subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding volume as the amount of space a 3D shape takes up, measured in unit cubes
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student fills a virtual box with unit cubes and counts them
exercise.pictorial: Student counts cubes shown in a pictured 3D block arrangement
exercise.abstract: Student states the volume in cubic units from a described stack of cubes

misconception_flags: counts only visible faces of cubes rather than all cubes including hidden ones

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
